kicker: Phrase of the day from the advanced vocabulary deck
headline: to bite off more than you can chew
subtitle: /tə baɪt ɒf mɔː ðən juː kən tʃuː/
body: To take on a task that is way too big, or to commit to more responsibilities than you can realistically handle in the time you have, and then struggle to finish any of them properly.
footnote: With three launches in one week, the team clearly bit off more than it could chew, and the retrospective said so plainly.
